'''Jeremy Tyler''' (born June 21st, 1991) is an American [[basketball]] player. Tyler is a 6'11" power forward/center from [[San Diego]], [[California]], [[United States]].

== High school ==
Tyler attended [[San Diego High School]], and played for the Cavers from 2005 to 2008. Tyler averaged 28.7 points per game during his junior season.<ref>[http://www.maxpreps.com/california/basketball/san-diego/jeremy-tyler/stats.aspx?athleteid=b9ccc313-c988-4401-ae9d-d849a8e2618b&SSID=08e31156-1f2d-4c08-b687-afb41d9f9601&urpath=,local,player Junior Stats]</ref> He decided to forgo his senior season to go play internationally for two years until he was eligible for the NBA Draft.

== College ==
On October 12, 2008, Tyler committed to [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]]. He chose Louisville over [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]] and [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]].  Tyler later retracted his commitment to Louisville and instead signed with an Israeli professional basketball club.

== Israel ==
On April 22, 2009, Tyler announced his intentions to skip his senior year in high school to play professionally abroad. On August 7, 2009, he signed a $140,000 deal with [[Maccabi Haifa B.C.|Maccabi Haifa]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Super League|Israeli Super League]].<ref name="M. Haifa official">[http://www.mhbasket.co.il/News.asp?id=602&lang=en M. Haifa signs high school phenom Jeremy Tyler]</ref>

Tyler played just 10 games, averaging only 2.1 PPG in 7.6 MPG. On March 18, 2010, he officially quit the team and headed home to San Diego.<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/news/story?id=5008825 Tyler quits Maccabi with 2 months left]</ref>

== Japan ==
On July 29, 2010, Tyler signed a contract with the [[Tokyo Apache]] of [[bj league|Japan's professional basketball league]]<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/news/story?id=5419379]</ref> because he was not eligible to place his name into the NBA draft until 2011.  In 33 games, he averaged 9.9 points on 51.7% shooting and 6.4 rebounds in 15.4 minutes per game. <ref>http://www.asia-basket.com/player.asp?Cntry=JPN&PlayerID=132227</ref> 
He is projected as a second round pick in the [[2011 NBA Draft]].<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Jeremy-Tyler-1327 Jeremy Tyler NBA Draft Profile]</ref>
